name: 3-D Thinning Skeleton
definition: Compresses a binary voxel object into a compact skeleton by iteratively deleting non-critical boundary points while preserving topology and geometric end points.
summary: 3-D Thinning Skeleton is a topology-preserving compression technique that iteratively deletes non-critical boundary points to reduce a voxel object to a compact skeleton, avoiding the excessive sub-branches found in Medial Axis Transform.
